request.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONLY a standalone Kalistar trading-card character painting, vertical 4:5 composition, not a card. Character: Commander White from NieR:Automata, adult female android leader. Reference 1 is exact identity and costume reference ONLY: long blonde high ponytail with braided crown, pale white high-collared long military dress with gold details, white thigh high boots, eyes uncovered. Do NOT use its anime linework, pose, text or page layout. References 2 Momo and 3 Kaylis define the mandatory PAINTED Kalistar art direction: confident visible brushstrokes, textured color planes, human-proportioned painted face, worn materials and hierarchical edges, never anime, smooth CGI or photoreal. Scene: Commander faces us frontally, standing straight nearly at military attention, boots grounded and shoulders square, arms straight at her sides with a slender gold command baton naturally down in one hand. Calm stern resolute expression with slight visible fatigue and responsibility in her eyes, not a fashion pose. She stands on the quiet central command deck of the orbital Bunker, dark graphite curved consoles and cool white overhead strip lighting, a broad rear observation window with Earth's luminous blue curve against black space. A few restrained warm console glows; credible orbital military station, no dense clutter. Full figure, hair, face and boots completely inside frame; head around 22 percent height, primary body in middle 55 percent of width so later card columns don't hide it. Soft blue reflected Earth light on the white uniform, warm light on expressive face. Detailed dignified narrative fantasy painting. Accurate single figure, two arms two legs, coherent hands and baton. No text, numbers, UI, symbols, logos, card frame or watermark.

review: Reviewed frontal straight posture, intact baton and hands, white costume, painted textures and expressive calm. Station is a scenic reinterpretation, not exact in-game geometry.
